_note: Ranges for the annex pass and premise step on the San Francisco 1994 thin-slice run. All but gap_year are ILLUSTRATIVE and must be sourced from material dated before enactment before this annex means anything.

market_growth.source: illustrative; to be sourced from pre-1994 San Francisco rent series

cap_growth.source: 60% of regional CPI (case text) times a CPI range of 2% to 3.5% (illustrative)

gap_year.source: horizon chosen for the annex (medium run)

supply_elasticity.source: illustrative long-run elasticity of rental supply from the covered stock

diverted_demand.source: illustrative: demand moved to uncovered units, as a share of their market

covered_units.source: illustrative count of rental units newly covered

exit_rate.source: illustrative: share of covered tenants who would leave the city each year without the measure

share_deterred.source: illustrative: share of those exits the lock-in prevents

conversion_rate.source: illustrative: share of covered units converted or withdrawn each year

share_displaced_leaving.source: illustrative: share of displaced households whose next home is outside the city

move_rate.source: illustrative: share of covered tenants who still move each year

share_diverted_out.source: illustrative: share of those movers diverted out of the city by higher free rents
